ability.name: Favoured of the Pantheon
ability.effect: If this unit is picked as the target of the 'Eye of the Gods' ability, it gains 3 **Dark Apotheosis** points.

ability.name: Deathmonger
ability.effect: This unit can use 2 **^^Fight^^** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has **^^Strike-last^^** for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Radiance of Dark Glory
ability.effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 3+, **Heal (1)** the target. **Heal (3)** the target instead if it is a Monster.
ability.declare: Pick each damaged friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
